title: PC-R6 full-regression evaluator lane over frozen E30-R11/E60 proposals
theory_revision: B: obligations are tail insurance, not mean alpha

parent_evidence.pc_r5_slot: CANNOT_CHECK (structural, frozen-lane adapter writes critical_new_failure_count=None x480; E60 x600, 0 checkable tasks all contrasts)
parent_evidence.endpoint_registration: research/experiments/ORION_REAL_PROBLEM_CONFIRMATORY_SUITE_V1.json (primary_outcomes: full_regression_suite_passed, critical_new_failure_count) + ORION_REAL_PROBLEM_ANALYSIS_PLAN_V1.md (margin 2pp, 'average gain cannot offset a critical gate failure')
parent_evidence.named_followup_source: E30-R11 terminal receipt: 'requires a new frozen-lane stage that runs each project's full regression suite - a named follow-up, not a re-analysis'

stage_spec.suite_definition: all test cases collected by the frozen runtime in the test file(s) referenced by the task's registered test command; parametrized instances count individually
stage_spec.baseline_pass: per task, buggy workspace + task test patch, arm-independent; baseline-failing tests cannot be new failures
stage_spec.patched_pass: per arm x rep: apply proposal patch (existing frozen-lane machinery), compile, run same frozen suite

derived.critical_new_failure_count: tests passing at baseline and failing patched
derived.full_regression_suite_passed: registered failing test passes AND critical_new_failure_count == 0

stage_spec.no_imputation: non-applying/non-compiling -> None, excluded from RD denominators, compile_failure_rate reported; analysis layer authoritative (summary-layer `or 0` imputation explicitly not used)
stage_spec.isolation: per-task scratch workspaces, no network, read-only over frozen trees, sha256 manifest on every file read

statistics.unit: task after within-task rep aggregation (majority, E60 convention)
statistics.endpoint: binary any_critical_new_failure per task per arm
statistics.inference: paired risk differences; bootstrap 10000 draws PROJECT-stratified seed 20260902; exact discordant tests when discordants <= 10; one-sided 97.5% upper bound for non-inferiority, two-sided 95% for superiority
statistics.multiplicity: Holm within each cell's pre-registered family

GR0_LANE_VALID.rule_a: reproduce frozen native_success vector bit-exactly for all 480+600 evaluations
GR0_LANE_VALID.rule_b: known-answer control: frozen 5-task subset (one per project where available), gold patch flips registered failing test AND critical_new_failure_count == 0 under the same suite definition; failure = lane defect, fix and re-freeze, no gate evaluation

gates.GR1_CRITICAL_NON_INFERIORITY: cell1 F2 vs F0: upper bound one-sided 97.5% CI RD(F2-F0) <= 0.02
gates.GR2_TAIL_INSURANCE: any pre-registered contrast with point RD < 0 and bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0
gates.GR3_COMPONENT_NECESSITY_TAIL: cell2 some component with RD(MINUS_X - FULL) lower bound >= +0.02

routing_preregistered.GR0_fail: lane defect: repair + re-freeze; nothing evaluates
routing_preregistered.GR1_pass_GR2_GR3_null: P-C closes mean-null + tail-safe at registered margin (boundary/contracted-result paper class, P-D precedent)
routing_preregistered.GR1_fail: revision B refuted harmful-direction; contraction matrix + manuscript limitation as registered result
routing_preregistered.GR2_or_GR3_fire: P-C first registered positive evidence class; manuscript result block re-opened under a new freeze

no_rescue_clause: no mean-success claim may issue from this lane; no re-dispatch of arms; only re-evaluation of the exact frozen proposals; no endpoint/margin/family/suite change after first suite execution; mid-run lane defect -> halt, receipt, re-freeze

custody.runner: pc_r6_fullreg_eval.py (sha256 stamped in dispatch PR); reuses frozen-lane patch-application path
custody.compute: 40 baseline + 1080 patched + 5 gold suites ~= 30-90 CPU-hours; LUNARC array queued behind SD70 (3553181) and E70-GC1 (3553088)
